system.notes: A person who slipped between moments and came back hungry. It flickers between where it is, where it was, and where the victim wishes it had gone.

Signature. Its footprints arrive after it does.

description.value: The wraith moves through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 1d10 kinetic damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

do.prompt: Incorporeal Slip: moves through creatures/objects; 1d10 kinetic if it ends its turn inside one.

description.value: After the wraith moves 2 squares or more, attack rolls against it reroll the highest die until the start of its next turn.
The wraith makes two Rift Claw attacks, or one Rift Claw attack and uses Phase Drain.

system.effect: The wraith tears the target with displaced time. On a hit, the target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

description.value:
Strike. reach 1 square., one target. Damage: 1d8 psychic + violence. Damage goes to Stress. On a hit, the target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

You feel it a second before it lands, and a second after.

system.effect: One target within 6 squares. rolls vs Resolve (DC 15). On a failed save the wraith then teleports to an unoccupied space within 1 square. of the target. On a success, half damage and no teleport.
system.flavor: It flickers to where you'll be standing, and drinks the difference.

description.value:
Save Attack. One target within 6 squares rolls Resolve vs DC 15. Hit: 4d8 qliphothic + soul. On a failed save the wraith then teleports to an unoccupied space within 1 square of the target. On a success, half damage and no teleport.

It flickers to where you'll be standing, and drinks the difference.

system.effect: Each creature of the wraith's choice within 4 squares. rolls vs Resolve (DC 15). Half damage on success. On a failure, the target is also slowed until the end of its next turn (movement halved, no reactions, action OR bonus action — not both). At the start of its turn it rolls 1d6; on a 5–6 it is ready again.
system.flavor: A second too late, a second too early — both happen to you at once.

description.value:
Area Attack. Each creature of the wraith's choice within 4 squares rolls Resolve vs DC 15. Hit: 4d6 psychic + soul; half on success. On a failure, the target is also slowed until the end of its next turn (movement halved, no reactions, action OR bonus action — not both).
Recharges on a Soma Break.

A second too late, a second too early — both happen to you at once.

do.prompt: Slowed: half move, action OR bonus action.

description.value: Reaction, when targeted by an attack the wraith can see: it teleports up to 3 squares to an unoccupied space it can see. The triggering attack rerolls the highest die.

rules.label: Slip the Frame — the wraith teleports up to 3 squares (GM moves it); the attack rolls 3 keep lowest

description.value: A creature that starts its turn within 2 squares of the wraith must succeed a Soul check vs DC 15 or have its movement reduced by 2 squares until the start of its next turn as local time thickens around it.

system.effect: Phase the Wraith partially out of the current frame. Until the start of its next turn, attackers reroll-lowest on attacks against it; on each missed attack, the attacker takes 1d6 qliphothic to Stress as the slip bleeds back into them.
system.flavor: The air around it remembers things that didn't happen.

manifestation.durationText: Until the next turn or dismissed.
manifestation.riskText: The Wraith may slip too far and lose 1 Integrity to a frame it can't return from.
manifestation.fictionalPermission: May refuse to be where it was.
manifestation.gmCalibration: Reroll-lowest on attacks; 1d6 qliphothic to Stress on misses.
manifestation.signature: The air remembers things that didn't happen.
manifestation.thirdThing: Anyone watching forgets where they were standing.

description.value:
Working. Stop being entirely present.

Phase the wraith partially out of the current frame. Until the start of its next turn, attackers reroll the highest die on attacks against it; each missed attack costs the attacker 1d6 qliphothic damage to Stress as the slip bleeds back into them.

Cost. 1 Clarity, +2 Noise · action · self / self.

The air around it remembers things that didn't happen.

do.prompt: Each miss costs the attacker 1d6 qliphothic to Stress.

description.value: Reaction, when struck: the wraith displaces 1 square. The attacker briefly forgets which target they aimed at — they reroll the highest die on their next attack roll this exchange.

do.prompt: The Wraith may displace 1 square (GM moves it).

description.value:
Until this creature attacks, attacks against it reroll the highest die. Its first strike fully manifests it for the rest of the scene. It moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain and takes 1d10 kinetic if it ends its turn inside something solid.

It is here. Sort of. The 'sort of' is the dangerous part.

rules.label: Half-Real — until the first strike manifests it

price.notes: TIII heavy dream — bounty 40 / hire 60 marks; credited to the pool matching the method (default nonlethal)
